content.intro: In this lesson, you will learn **Reified Types and Advanced Generics** as part of **Advanced Kotlin Language Features**. Generics preserve relationships between types and reduce unsafe casts; type constraints and variance should be as simple as the API requires. Use the subtopics—Runtime Type Checks with Reified Parameters, Building Generic Utility APIs, Limitations of Reified Generics—as a checklist: predict what the example will do, then verify it in a project configured for the target platform.
content.why_it_matters: Professional applications need repeatable tests, clear APIs, dependable dependencies, security checks, and observable failures. Apply this concept in small steps before integrating it into a larger project.
